title: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
description: The Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship is offered to talented students who are enrolling in a bachelor degree and are citizens of countries where international educational opportunities are limited by financial disadvantage. It provides a fee sponsorship (20 per cent from 2027) for the duration of the course, with no separate application required.

program_type: Post-admission merit scholarship for international coursework students
duration: One year (paid in two equal instalments per semester) or one semester, depending on the award amount
description: Five scholarship amounts are offered based on your ranking against the selection criteria:

title: Annie Farrand Scholarship in Agricultural Science (International)
program_type: Undergraduate merit scholarship restricted to a single degree
duration: Up to 3 years, full-time study only
description: This scholarship is valued at $20,000 per annum and is tenable for 3 years.

title: UWA Global Excellence Scholarship
duration: The normal full-time duration of the awardee's course as specified in their letter of offer
description: *International and overseas qualifications achieved at a certain level make you eligible for this scholarship. Other programs or qualifications will be considered on an individual basis.

title: Monash International Leadership Scholarship
program_type: Automatic-consideration undergraduate tuition scholarship for international students
duration: Duration of the undergraduate degree, until the minimum number of points for the degree are completed
description: The Monash International Leadership Scholarship is a merit-based award for international students who have received a full, unconditional Monash course offer and will enrol full-time in an undergraduate degree at an Australian Monash campus. Recipients receive 100% of their course fees until the minimum number of points for their degree are completed, with OSHC, accommodation and living costs excluded. title: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
official_source: U.S. Department of State (Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs)
program_type: Non-degree professional fellowship for mid-career professionals
duration: Ten-month fellowship year (one academic year of study plus a pre-academic English and professional program), plus a six-week Professional Affiliation
description: The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program is a U.S. Department of State fellowship, administered by the Institute of International Education, for mid-career professionals from eligible countries. It is a non-degree program: fellows may take academic coursework at a U.S. host university but do not earn a degree. The package covers host-university tuition and fees, a maintenance allowance with a one-time settling-in allowance, accident and sickness insurance, a book allowance, a one-time computer subsidy, international and programme-event air travel, and a professional development allowance. title: University of Miami Stamps Scholarship
program_type: Merit-based university scholarship (Stamps Foundation-endowed premier scholarship)
duration: Up to eight semesters, or ten semesters for students in five-year degree programs, or until completion of the first degree, whichever is sooner
description: The Stamps Scholarship is the University of Miami's most prestigious merit award, given to exceptional and academically accomplished high school seniors who apply and are admitted through Early Decision I or Early Action. Stamps Scholars receive the full cost of attendance for up to eight semesters (ten for five-year programs) or until completion of their first degree, whichever comes first. The package covers tuition and fees, on-campus housing, a meal plan, University health insurance, textbooks and a laptop allowance, plus access to a $12,000 enrichment fund.
